verdict.rationale: A documented public API is a fair question for a government business-filing service. The evidence only describes SOSPortal as a human-facing web portal (filing, drafts, shopping cart, MFA, a $1 pay-per-search fee) plus downloadable PDF forms, with no API, developer documentation or programmatic endpoints. The filing host's robots.txt also bans AI agents by name, so nothing shows the product can be driven through a documented public API.
